text:
olivia (People Ops): Heads-up: Saras contractor payout in Canada (Jan 2026) was processed as contractor expense, but her US payroll in Feb also withheld Social Security. Looks like duplicate employee social withhold. @sam can you confirm what landed on the Feb paystub?

sam (Payroll): Confirmed  Feb paystub shows employee SS withheld 6.2% on the Feb earnings, and the Canada invoice shows CPP deducted at source. We need invoice copy + remittance evidence to decide reclaim vs retro credit. If CRA/Canada already withheld CPP, reclaim possibility depends on treaty and whether the payment was for services performed entirely while resident in Canada.

mira (Finance): For cashflow we can issue an off-cycle net reimbursement to Sara once docs + JE are in. Please send invoice + bank remittance to finance-payroll@redwood.com. Also need a short manager approval note.

sara (Employee): I uploaded the invoice and bank payment confirmation to my HR folder (onboard/sara/contractor-payments). Contractor tax id: CA-987654321. I was physically in Toronto Jan 102026 and returned to SF Feb 1 2026. Let me know if you need a signed attestation.

sam (Payroll): Got files. Given the travel dates, it might be dual-withhold. If CRA withheld CPP, reclaim route is longer. Interim: off-cycle gross-up or net credit. I'll prepare the off-cycle estimate. Codes: `OFFCYCLE_PAY | GL:6400 | NOTE: crossborder-dup-CPP`.

ben (Manager): Approve off-cycle net reimbursement to make Sara whole immediately. Please include note: "manager approved - make whole for duplicate social withholding pending reclaim."

olivia (People Ops): Approved. @mira please create JE and flag for tax-team review so we can attempt reclaim with CRA counsel afterward.

mira (Finance): JE created JE-2026-078 "Off-cycle reimbursement - Sara duplicate social withhold". Uploaded docs to finance drive and emailed tax@redwood.com.

payroll-bot: Off-cycle job queued: 2026-02-offcycle job id 25678. Requires JE and attachments before processing. https://payroll.redwood.com/jobs/25678 :clipboard:

sam (Payroll): Scheduling off-cycle once JE attachments confirmed. I'll include a reconciliation line and label the transaction `reclaim-pending`. Will update thread when processed or if tax needs more info.

sara (Employee): Thanks everyone  appreciate the quick help. Happy to sign any attestation or provide boarding/flight docs if that helps with the CRA reclaim.
